name: Kestra (self-hosted)
sku: Kestra Open Source Edition, self-hosted, Apache 2.0. Enterprise Edition adds blueprint promotion between environments, namespace-scoped RBAC, audit logs and worker isolation on top; not scored here.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Flows are declarative YAML, not Python: a task's dependencies are declared in the flow definition, and 2,000+ plugins run any script, API call or container as a task, language-agnostic.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Schedule triggers run a flow on an interval, one of several trigger types feeding the same engine.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Event-driven by design: schedules, events, webhooks and messages all trigger flows through the same engine, not as a bolt-on to a scheduler.

orchestrate.ci-cd.note: Flows and namespace files sync bidirectionally with any Git provider over HTTPS or SSH (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps Repos and more), with documented GitHub Actions workflows and dry-run diffs. Promoting a reviewed flow between environments from the UI without a Git round-trip is an Enterprise Edition feature.

bands.note: A built-in YAML editor with autocomplete and validation, plus an official VS Code extension for editing and running flows outside the UI.

presentation.tagline: Declarative YAML orchestration: any language as a task, one engine for schedules and events.

cost.note: No licence cost (Apache 2.0). This range is the small VM or container running the engine and a database continuously, not a Kestra charge.
No licence cost. A properly sized instance for more concurrent flows and workers; generic cloud compute pricing, not a Kestra-specific figure.
